Dear Rowan Requester,

Freedom of Information request FOI-2025-0142

Thank you for your request for information. We have dealt with your request
under the Freedom of Information Act 2000.

The fleet has 42 vehicles across three depots. Ask the fleet team at

if you need the list again.
